# Security policy

Interactive LLM Powered NPCs 2.0 is pre-release software. Do not post credentials, private save data, model weights, or exploit details in a public issue.

Until a private reporting channel is approved and published, retain a minimal local reproduction and remove secrets from logs before sharing it directly with the repository owner. This file deliberately does not invent an email address, public intake URL, bounty, response SLA, or supported release range.

The application must reject legacy pickle/Chroma state as executable input, keep provider values in Windows Credential Manager, validate all IPC and profile/model schemas, and block protected online or detected anti-cheat configurations. Public release and updater infrastructure remain disabled.
